data.long_meaning: From the Old English words wil, meaning 'will,' and weard, meaning 'guardian' or 'protector.' Willard is a strong, courageous name that evokes images of a determined warrior. The name Willard carries the meaning “Resolute warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Willard usually hope their child will grow to embody resolute warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
